query: What reproducibility artifacts must accompany the code release: a minimal YAML/JSON hyperparameter manifest, unit tests (spectral Hermitian symmetry, SDF zero-crossings), and a compact end-to-end script mapping raw DICOM/NIfTI to logged experiment outputs and container spec?

response.query: What reproducibility artifacts must accompany the code release: a minimal YAML/JSON hyperparameter manifest, unit tests (spectral Hermitian symmetry, SDF zero-crossings), and a compact end-to-end script mapping raw DICOM/NIfTI to logged experiment outputs and container spec?
response.answer: For code release, include a minimal hyperparameter manifest, unit tests, and a compact script for end-to-end data processing, along with a container specification.

results.title: [2305.12571] Reproducibility Requires Consolidated Artifacts - arXiv
results.content: We evaluate the sources of reproducibility failures using a meta-analysis of 142 replication studies from ReScience C and 204 code repositories.
